Qhull 2003.1 (released 2003/12/30) - modification notice
========================================================

This directory contains Qhull 2003.1, obtained from http://www.qhull.org, in
modified form.  See upstream/COPYING.txt for the licence.  Clause 2 of that
licence requires COPYING.txt to be distributed with any copy of Qhull,
including a copy inside a larger product; it is at
External/qhull/upstream/COPYING.txt and must travel with this directory.


ORIGINAL SOURCE  (clause 4)
---------------------------
The original, unmodified source code for Qhull may be obtained via http from
www.qhull.org.  The version vendored here is Qhull 2003.1, whose source archive
qhull-2003.1.tar.gz has SHA-256
c97d1982e6f5423379bf0ad6dd7293886ac69cae1596b59a305614aec4ae54f8.

An unmodified copy of that archive's src/ directory is also kept here, at
External/qhull/upstream/src/, and is checked byte-for-byte against the archive
on every build.  The modifications below are the difference between that
directory and External/qhull/novodex/.


MODIFICATIONS  (clause 3)
-------------------------
Clause 3 requires, for every modification, a notice giving the name of the
person performing it, the date, and the reason.  There are two entries because
Qhull has been modified twice: once by NovodeX, and once by this project in the
course of reconstructing what NovodeX did.

1.  Modified by: NovodeX AG (the original modification, reconstructed here,
                 not performed by this project).
    Date:        on or before 2005, the build date of the reference binary
                 NxPhysics.dll (SHA-256 4b7db3e126735c576f79fe5666e6fa661de972
                 4b2a78808bb0924325ac79602c).
    Reason:      to route Qhull's diagnostic output, its allocation and its
                 error exit through the host engine's own interfaces instead of
                 the C library, and to drive Qhull from an in-process
                 convex-hull cooker rather than from a command-line program.

2.  Modified by: the NovodeX Physics reconstruction project.
    Date:        2026-08-12.
    Reason:      to reproduce modification 1 in source form.  The reference
                 binary cannot be reproduced without it, and a vendored stock
                 tree would silently differ from the binary this project exists
                 to reproduce.  The changes are confined to
                 External/qhull/novodex/ and are listed, with the address in the
                 reference binary that establishes each one, in
                 External/qhull/MODIFICATIONS.md.

    (Append one entry per further change.  Clause 3 requires a name, a date and
    a reason for every modification, so this file grows rather than being
    rewritten.)


COPYRIGHT NOTICES  (clause 1)
-----------------------------
All copyright notices in the original files are intact.  Every modified file
carries its NovodeX marker BELOW the Geometry Center header, never in place of
it, for exactly this reason.
